ai_engineer.short_description: Build intelligent systems, predictive algorithms, machine learning models, and deep learning architectures.

financial_fit.action_recommendation: Partially Affordable. Explore National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or consider low-cost B.Sc Computer Science / BCA alternatives to close the ₹2,00,000 gap.

roadmap.title: Complete 12th / Higher Secondary
roadmap.short_description: Focus on Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) with a minimum 75% aggregate to qualify for top engineering entrances.

checklist: Maintain 75%+ score in Class 12 Boards
Register for JEE Main / CUET Entrance Examinations
Build baseline math intuition for Linear Algebra

roadmap.title: Choose Relevant Degree Path
roadmap.short_description: Enroll in B.Tech / B.E. (CSE, IT, AI & Data Science) or alternative cost-effective paths like B.Sc Computer Science.

checklist: Select accredited college with active campus placement cells
Apply for tuition fee waiver (TFW) or merit scholarships
Join college tech clubs (ACM, IEEE, GDSC)

roadmap.title: Build Programming Foundation
roadmap.short_description: Master core object-oriented programming, algorithm analysis, and clean code practices using Python and C++.

checklist: Solve 100+ problems on LeetCode / HackerRank
Create a clean GitHub profile and publish code
Master Version Control (Git commits, branching)

roadmap.title: Learn AI & Math Fundamentals
roadmap.short_description: Master linear algebra, probability, vector calculus, statistical inference, and classical Machine Learning algorithms.

courses: Mathematics for Machine Learning (Imperial College London)
checklist: Implement Regression and Classification algorithms from scratch
Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on Kaggle datasets
Understand Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC metrics

roadmap.title: Advanced Skills: Deep Learning & NLP
roadmap.short_description: Explore Neural Networks, Convolutional Networks (CNNs), Transformers, Natural Language Processing, and LLM fine-tuning.

projects: Custom RAG AI Chatbot with LangChain
checklist: Train a deep neural network on GPU (Google Colab / Kaggle)
Fine-tune an open-weight LLM (Llama 3 / Mistral)
Understand vector databases (ChromaDB / Pinecone)

roadmap.title: Build Practical Projects Portfolio
roadmap.short_description: Develop 2–4 production-ready, full-stack AI applications with web endpoints and deploy them live.

checklist: Containerize models using Docker
Deploy AI API endpoints on AWS / Hugging Face Spaces / Render
Record 2-minute video demos for LinkedIn

roadmap.title: Gain Industry Internship Experience
roadmap.short_description: Apply for summer internships, open-source programs (GSoC), or research assistant roles to work on real dataset pipelines.

checklist: Prepare tailored AI resume highlighting GitHub projects
Apply via LinkedIn, Internshala, and Y Combinator Work at a Startup
Contribute to open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, HuggingFace)

roadmap.title: Acquire Industry Certifications
roadmap.short_description: Validate your expertise with recognized cloud and machine learning certifications.

courses: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty Prep
checklist: Pass AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or GCP Professional ML Engineer
Add badge to LinkedIn and Resume

roadmap.title: Apply for AI Engineer Job Roles
roadmap.short_description: Target entry-level AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or AI Research Associate positions.

courses: Machine Learning System Design Interview Prep
checklist: Prepare for Live Coding and System Design rounds
Network with Senior AI Engineers and Tech Lead Managers
Secure entry-level job offer as AI/ML Engineer

exams.name: JEE Main
exams.purpose: Admissions to NITs, IIITs, CFTIs, and qualifying for JEE Advanced.
exams.why_it_matters: Primary Gateway for top-tier Indian Engineering colleges with high campus placements in AI companies.

exams.name: JEE Advanced
exams.purpose: Admissions to premier Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs).
exams.eligibility: Top 2,50,000 qualifiers of JEE Main Paper 1.
exams.why_it_matters: Unlocks world-class AI research labs and top global tech recruiters.

exams.name: BITSAT
exams.purpose: Admissions to BITS Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad Campuses.
exams.eligibility: 12th PCM with 75% aggregate & 60% in each subject.
exams.why_it_matters: Top tier private institution with zero attendance policy and strong AI startup culture.

exams.name: CUET UG
exams.purpose: Admissions to Central Universities (DU, BHU, JNU) for B.Sc CS / BCA.
exams.why_it_matters: Extremely affordable alternative pathway into prestigious Central Universities.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme (NSP)
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Govt of India
scholarships.eligibility: Above 80th percentile in 12th Board + Family income < ₹4.5 Lakh/yr.
scholarships.why_eligible: Matches student income profile and high 12th merit standing.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: First-year undergraduate students in STEM + Household income < ₹15 Lakhs.
scholarships.why_eligible: High financial aid grant aimed at STEM students pursuing AI & Tech.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
scholarships.eligibility: Female students admitted to 1st year B.Tech/Diploma + Income < ₹8 Lakhs.
scholarships.benefit: ₹50,000 per annum towards tuition and incidental expenses
scholarships.why_eligible: Dedicated financial empowerment grant for women in tech.

alternative_pathways.title: B.Tech Computer Science (AI Specialization)
alternative_pathways.advantages: Structured campus placements, hardware labs, traditional industry recognition.
alternative_pathways.trade_offs: Higher tuition fees; rigid curriculum schedule.
alternative_pathways.next_step: Prepare for JEE Main & State CETs.

alternative_pathways.title: B.Sc Computer Science + Self-Paced AI Bootcamps
alternative_pathways.advantages: Substantially lower tuition fees; 1 year saved; flexible study hours.
alternative_pathways.trade_offs: Requires self-discipline for online AI projects.
alternative_pathways.next_step: Apply via CUET UG / State University Merit List.

alternative_pathways.title: BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) + Cloud Certs
alternative_pathways.advantages: Strong application software foundation; affordable; easy eligibility.
alternative_pathways.trade_offs: May require MCA or strong portfolio for top AI R&D labs.
alternative_pathways.next_step: Enroll in local accredited college + Coursera AI track.

alternative_pathways.title: IIT Madras Online BS in Data Science & Programming
alternative_pathways.advantages: Direct IIT quality education; study alongside job/local college; highly practical.
alternative_pathways.next_step: Register for Qualifier Exam on IIT Madras Portal.

next_steps: Start Machine Learning Math (Linear Algebra & Applied Statistics).
Build one end-to-end Machine Learning web application.
Explore National Scholarship Portal (NSP) for tuition support.
Target summer AI internships or open-source contributions.

data_scientist.short_description: Analyze large complex datasets, discover business insights, build predictive models, and drive data-driven decision making.
data_scientist.education_level: Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc Stats / B.Tech CSE / BCA)

financial_fit.action_recommendation: Good Financial Fit. Estimated education expenses fit comfortably within your available family budget.

roadmap.title: Complete 12th Science / Commerce with Math
roadmap.short_description: Focus on Mathematics and Statistics with a strong foundation in data analysis.

checklist: Complete 12th with 70%+ score
Build mathematical intuition

roadmap.title: Choose Degree (B.Sc Statistics / B.Tech / BCA)
roadmap.short_description: Enroll in a quantitative degree focused on statistics, math, or computer applications.

checklist: Maintain 7.5+ CGPA
Learn relational databases

roadmap.title: Master Data Wrangling (Python & SQL)
roadmap.short_description: Learn SQL queries, Pandas, Data Cleaning, Visualization (Seaborn, Matplotlib, PowerBI).

checklist: Solve 50+ SQL queries on HackerRank
Create interactive dashboard

exams.name: CUET PG / ISI Admission Test
exams.purpose: Admissions to Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) & Central Universities.
exams.why_it_matters: Premier statistical institute in Asia with elite research and salary packages.

next_steps: Master Advanced SQL joins, window functions, and indexing.
Complete Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate.
Build a Kaggle exploratory data analysis portfolio project.
